mainEntity.name: How often should commercial AC units be serviced in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: For commercial premises in Dubai we recommend a service every three months, with a full duct clean once a year.

mainEntity.name: Do you serve both the UAE and Saudi Arabia?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We operate in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah in the UAE, and in Riyadh and Jeddah in Saudi Arabia.
